name: Gosen (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Gosen city emblem in light blue, green and blue: stylised human figures in light blue and blue above green leaf-like strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Gosen, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 June 2006.

features.role: Gosen city emblem — stylised human figures in light blue and blue above green leaf-like strokes
